thread:
sam-recruiter: FYI new hire Leo starts on Dec 20 (APAC). There's a company shutdown Dec 24-27 and PTO blackout Dec 22-28. Is there a proration exception for people who convert from contractor->FT during the week?

nidhi-peopleops: Hi all 0: short answer: yes, we have a "mid-joiner pro-rate" flow but conversion during blackout needs a note. If someone starts or converts inside a blackout, we can grant emergency floating days or mark shutdown days separately, depending on FTE start date + payroll cutoffs.

alex-mgr: Leo is converting to FT on Dec 21 per offer. He'd otherwise have 0 accrued PTO by company policy until Jan 1. Need clarity so he can travel home on Dec 25.

nidhi-peopleops: Steps: 1) Submit People Portal -> Leave Exceptions -> "Pro-rate for Mid-Joiner/Conversion". 2) Attach signed offer and conversion date. 3) Manager approval + People Ops sign-off. 4) Payroll will apply prorated accrual or grant 2 emergency shutdown days depending on cutoff. Note payroll cutoff is Dec 15 for Dec pay.

leo-newhire: If payroll cutoff blocks a payout, will the floating days be taken from next year's bank or added as separate "shutdown credit"?

finance-bot: Policy lookup: for conversions before payroll cutoff, we prorate accrual into current year. After cutoff, we issue "shutdown credit" (non-accrual) that does not reduce future PTO bank. Vendor/contractor payrolls may be handled differently.

nidhi-peopleops: To get this done: sam please submit on Leo's behalf or share the signed docs. Alex please approve in portal. If we miss Dec 15 cutoff we'll grant 2 shutdown credits for Dec 24-25 and process Jan 5 payroll for any cash adjustments.

alex-mgr: Approved. Submitted docs.

sam-recruiter: Done, ticket EX-2025-1002 created.

nidhi-peopleops: Great. Marking EX-2025-1002 as "pro-rate pending payroll". Will update once payroll confirms. Leo, welcome aboard!

leo-newhire: Thanks all 600. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

nidhi-peopleops: If anyone else has conversion during blackout, batch them to avoid multiple payroll exceptions. PM me for bulk handling.
